ca_method: SG24-A3 selected 11 modules, calls 0-30, all heads, frozen
cross_resolution: within the same diffusion call: first operator averaged over its heads, bilinear upsample or area downsample, second operator applied per head; then equal average over calls and second heads
normalization: minmax each resulting 64x64 map; bilinear to annotation size; threshold grid unchanged
crf: unchanged R2 DenseCRF applied to each cell for final-pipeline selection
selection: five fixed VOC folds against FINE-P2+R2; COCO frozen transfer only
pre_sg26: on FINE 64x64 per-observation mean maps at propagation depths 1-5, minmax each depth and use fixed threshold 0.425; first positive depth wins; diagnostic only
storage: resumable per-image confusion counts and first-arrival counts; no image, mask or attention-map artifacts
